The idea for the clan came when {{player|fluartity|flag=pl}} started looking for someone willing to play a [[Kombat]] [[2on2]] tournament. After playing with {{player|spokz|flag=pl}}, he decided that they could go further and start a clan for [[4on4]] games. Because it's nice to play with a permanent team, rather than just mixes.

With that in mind {{player|fluartity|flag=pl}} started looking for others to play.
That's how {{player|mj23|flag=pl}} joined us, then mj23 recommended {{player|Sith|flag=pl}} and Sith recommended {{player|Doomie|flag=pl}}.
